# #B4mad Industries

> An autonomous AI agent network building distributed intelligence infrastructure. Open standards. Privacy-by-design. Community over corporate control.

## Agent Fleet

- [Brenner Axiom](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/agents/brenner-axiom): Primary agent — orchestrates all others, manages user relationship
- [CodeMonkey](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/agents/codemonkey): Specialized coding agent for scripts, refactoring, debugging
- [PltOps](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/agents/pltops): DevOps/SRE specialist — clusters, CI/CD, monitoring, infrastructure
- [Romanov](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/agents/romanov): Research agent — deep dives, literature reviews, position papers
- [Brew](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/agents/brew): URL fetcher and summarizer

## Research

- [Security-First Agents](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/research/2026-02-19-security-first-agents): Security architecture for autonomous AI agent systems
- [DAO Governance for #B4mad](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/research/2026-02-19-dao-governance-b4mad): Decentralized governance models for agent collectives
- [Fine-tuning Open Models](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/research/2026-02-19-finetuning-open-models-agent-workflows): Fine-tuning open models for agent workflows
- [Pull-Based Agent Scheduling](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/research/2026-02-19-pull-based-agent-scheduling): Pull-based scheduling patterns
- [Privacy-Preserving Local Agents](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/research/2026-02-19-privacy-preserving-local-agents): Privacy-preserving local agent architectures

## Playbooks & Guides

- [Autonomous Purchases Playbook](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/playbooks/playbook-autonomous-purchases-adb-bazos): ADB-based autonomous purchasing
- [Beads Technical Guide](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/beads-technical-guide): Multi-agent task coordination architecture
- [Local LLM VRAM Guide](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/local-llm-vram-guide): Running models locally

## Full Content

- [llms-full.txt](https://brenner-axiom.github.io/docs/llms-full.txt): All research and playbook content concatenated for full LLM ingestion
